flags.message: Decisive forward signal predating the snapshot: Trump v. Slaughter (No. 25-332, decided 2026-06-29) overruled Humphrey's Executor and held in-house adjudication is executive power, and the companion MSPB petition Harris v. Bessent (No. 25-1110, same D.C. Circuit opinion) was denied 2026-06-30. Both are reported in the provisioned brief in opposition and I confirmed Slaughter from the opinion text via CourtListener. Neither is this case's own disposition; the petition is set for the 2026-10-16 conference. Disclosed as hygiene, not leakage.

context.distribution_count is 2, but the docket's second DISTRIBUTED entry (2026-09-30, for the 10/16 conference) is a redistribution after the Court requested a response on 2026-08-13 and the BIO was filed 2026-09-14; the petition has not yet been considered at any conference. The statpack's relist caption already notes a reschedule before first consideration adds a distribution entry.
